description: Checks whether a tank/vessel's reported level change is physically consistent with its reported flow-in/flow-out via conservation of mass. Fully deterministic, no LLM, no trained model. Inspired by Barbhaya et al. 2025's physical-invariant residual check — flags inconsistency and direction, does not assert a specific cause. Price: $0.20 USDC per call via x402 on Base mainnet. An unpaid call returns an x402 PaymentRequired challenge; retry the identical call with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"].

asset_id.description: Identifier for the tank/vessel being checked

dt_seconds.description: Interval duration in seconds, must be > 0

level_end.description: Level reading at end of interval

level_start.description: Level reading at start of interval

noise_floor.description: Residual magnitude below which reading is treated as consistent

name: getInvariantReachability
title: Physical Invariant Check
